QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` (`include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787`), `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (`:2196`) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (`:2185`) all default to off.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the shipped config.h has the threading macros (THREADING_C, PTHREAD, ALT) off by default, so a default build defines none of them.
